def MathResearch.Spinor.SphericalMeanValueOnBall : Prop :=
∀ (E : Type) [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (F : ℍ → E),
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F Ball →
    InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd F Ball →
      ∀ q ∈ Ball, ∫ (a : ↥Fueter.UnitQuaternion), F ((↑a)⁻¹ * q) ∂unitQuaternionHaar = F 0
def MathResearch.Spinor.RadialMeanValueOnBall : Prop :=
∀ (E : Type) [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀ (F : ℍ → E),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F Ball →
        InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd F Ball →
          Integrable F (weightedBallMeasure n) → ∫ (q : ℍ), F q ∂weightedBallMeasure n = F 0

def MathResearch.Spinor.regularCoefficient : (n : ℕ) →
  (hn : 2 ≤ n) → ↥(BinaryForm n) → ↥(WeakBallSpace n hn) → Sp11 → ℂ :=
fun n hn v f g => inner ℂ ((constantRegularIsometry n hn) v) (((regularRepresentation n hn) g⁻¹) f)
def MathResearch.Spinor.coefficientNormConstant : (n : ℕ) → ↥(BinaryForm n) → ℝ :=
fun n v => ‖v‖ ^ 2 / ((↑n + 1) * weightConstant n)
def MathResearch.Spinor.compactHaar : Measure CompactPair :=
unitQuaternionHaar.prod unitQuaternionHaar
def MathResearch.Spinor.unitQuaternionHaar : Measure ↥Fueter.UnitQuaternion :=
Measure.haarMeasure ⊤

fun {G} [Group G] [MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableMul G] μ [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] =>
  {
    toFun := fun a =>
      let __LinearEquiv :=
        let __LinearMap := (leftL2Translation μ a).toLinearMap;
        { toLinearMap := __LinearMap, invFun := ⇑(leftL2Translation μ a⁻¹), left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯ };
      { toLinearEquiv := __LinearEquiv, norm_map' := ⋯ },
    map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯ }

MathResearch.Spinor.DS4_v1_of_background (meanValue : RadialMeanValueOnBall) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (μG : Measure Sp11)
  (haar : QuotientHaarIntegration μG) (v : ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1))) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
  have this := ⋯;
  ∃ W,
    (∀ (f : ↥(WeakBallSpace (m + 1) ⋯)), ↑↑(W f) =ᵐ[μG] regularCoefficient (m + 1) ⋯ v f) ∧
      (∀ (f : ↥(WeakBallSpace (m + 1) ⋯)), ‖W f‖ ^ 2 = coefficientNormConstant (m + 1) v * ‖f‖ ^ 2) ∧
        Function.Injective ⇑W ∧
          IsClosed (Set.range ⇑W) ∧
            (∀ (a : Sp11) (f : ↥(WeakBallSpace (m + 1) ⋯)),
                W (((regularRepresentation (m + 1) ⋯) a) f) = ((leftL2Representation μG) a) (W f)) ∧
              UnitaryInvariant (leftL2Representation μG) W.range
